method: CABAL v2.0: every supported broad spot asset reaches execution analysis; Stage-A/top-30 never gates execution. One canonical engine emits WATCH or BUY_NOW. CORE assets are mandatory, low-rank exchange-native momentum has a guarded reserve, BUY requires fresh 15m confirmation plus stop/no-chase safety, and NTFY relays/revalidates rather than re-scoring. Missed movers are recorded with reject reasons. Manual SPOT only.
